title: [BUG] Browser Agent ignores settings.json overrides (e.g., maxTurns)

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports a bug where the Browser Agent ignores settings.json configuration overrides (such as maxTurns), unlike other sub-agents. It provides specific details about the unexpected behavior, client environment, root cause analysis, and affected files.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug is localized to packages/core/src/agents/browser/browserAgentFactory.ts. Updating createBrowserAgentDefinition to check for and use the existing definition registered in AgentRegistry (or fall back to BrowserAgentDefinition) requires modifying a single source file and adding a unit test in browserAgentFactory.test.ts.

summary.problem: The Browser Agent ignores configuration overrides specified in settings.json (such as maxTurns and maxTimeMinutes).
summary.root_cause: When the Browser Agent is invoked, createBrowserAgentDefinition in browserAgentFactory.ts instantiates a fresh BrowserAgentDefinition object rather than retrieving the pre-merged agent definition from AgentRegistry, which already has settings.json overrides applied.
summary.context: Other sub-agents registered in AgentRegistry receive merged runConfig and modelConfig settings overrides upon initialization. Browser Agent bypasses this because createBrowserAgentDefinition recreates the definition directly.

steps: Retrieve any pre-registered definition from the AgentRegistry using config.getAgentRegistry()?.getDefinition(BROWSER_AGENT_NAME).

If a registry definition exists, use it as the base definition so that settings.json overrides (such as runConfig) are preserved; otherwise fall back to calling BrowserAgentDefinition(config, !visionDisabledReason).
Construct the final LocalAgentDefinition by combining the base definition with updated promptConfig and toolConfig containing discovered MCP tools.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When settings.json contains overrides for browser_agent (e.g. runConfig with maxTurns: 10), createBrowserAgentDefinition should return a definition that includes the overridden runConfig values from the AgentRegistry.
verification_steps: Add a test case in browserAgentFactory.test.ts where AgentRegistry contains a browser_agent definition with runConfig overrides.
Assert that createBrowserAgentDefinition returns an agent definition that preserves the runConfig overrides from AgentRegistry.
